entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I entered the War Room, Genera..."
entries.dialogueText: When I entered the War Room, General Taddeus Azaro was in his wheelchair next to the window.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""All my life, I was told I was mean..."
entries.dialogueText: "All my life, I was told I was meant for greatness."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Once again, presenting the same ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once again, presenting the same news that I delivered to King Valero so many years ago."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My life has been nothing but a ser..."
entries.dialogueText: "My life has been nothing but a series of failures."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yet here I am. Defeated, unworthy...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet here I am. Defeated, unworthy. I can't even stand on my own two feet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Spare me your antics.""
entries.dialogueText: "Spare me your antics."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Clearly. Because you are weak.""
entries.dialogueText: "Clearly. Because you are weak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is always hope. No matter ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is always hope. No matter how dire the situation is."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We have news from the frontline, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have news from the frontline, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Pales still stands despite our att..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales still stands despite our attacks on their heartland."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Palesian army has pushed us ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesian army has pushed us back from the border into the Pales Administrative District."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We've lost Terador and Fort Ales...."
entries.dialogueText: "We've lost Terador and Fort Ales. The frontline is broken."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Once we exhausted our troops, they..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once we exhausted our troops, they managed to push us back, retaking Arces."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We are holding them at the frontli..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are holding them at the frontline on an equal footing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They do not seem to be currently a..."
entries.dialogueText: "They do not seem to be currently advancing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I have failed. This burden is..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I have failed. This burden is mine to bear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But our operation has failed.""
entries.dialogueText: "But our operation has failed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her words sank deep into my mind."
entries.dialogueText: Her words sank deep into my mind.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is no one to blame. We must..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is no one to blame. We must look to the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And where were you when we were lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And where were you when we were losing this war, Duchess?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please don't blame my daughter, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't blame my daughter, Your Majesty. This is entirely on me, not her."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I know, Your Majesty. It is all my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Your Majesty. It is all my fault."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""That's generous of you to say, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's generous of you to say, Your Majesty. But we all know but we all know the failure is mine."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""No, Your Majesty. It is all my fau..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. It is all my fault. I'm the one whose to blame. Not you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Before we figure out who is to bla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we figure out who is to blame, I suggest we discuss what happens next."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can we still win?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can we still win?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do you think we should sue for pea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think we should sue for peace?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How long can we afford to keep the..."
entries.dialogueText: "How long can we afford to keep the war going?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would the Palesians be able to mar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would the Palesians be able to march on Porte Drazon?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In light of this information, I kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of this information, I know what needs to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need to discuss anything...."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need to discuss anything. The path forward is clear. I know what needs to be done."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""With the current state of the war,..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the current state of the war, no. But, times change, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If we keep the war going, we might..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we keep the war going, we might eventually have an opportunity."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If we sue for peace, we will lose..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we sue for peace, we will lose face in the eyes of the world."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, however, our enemy might seiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, however, our enemy might seize one for themselves."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It is a risk, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is a risk, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I think we should keep this going..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we should keep this going as far as we can. The international ramifications would render Rizia crippled."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I disagree. This war can bring dow..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. This war can bring down Rizia along with Pales. Not to mention the resources we have already spent."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We should sue for peace and look f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should sue for peace and look forward as a country."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Unless the situation changes drast..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless the situation changes drastically... potentially years."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In the end, we have more resources..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, we have more resources than Pales. We would win the war of attrition."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We would, yes. But at what cost?""
entries.dialogueText: "We would, yes. But at what cost?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Highly unlikely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Highly unlikely."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But not impossible.""
entries.dialogueText: "But not impossible."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If they keep pushing into Montakla..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they keep pushing into Montaklar, they will gain a foothold in Rizia's heartland."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I knew you would, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I knew you would, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What is your decision?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is your decision?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will approach Pales to sue for..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will approach Pales to sue for peace. I do not wish any more blood to be spilled."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will continue fighting until th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will continue fighting until the last drop of blood. We have to keep pushing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A sound decision, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "A sound decision, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Very well. Peace it is, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Peace it is, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Azaro looked outside the wi..."
entries.dialogueText: General Azaro looked outside the window again.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I am sorry for failing you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry for failing you."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""And you as well.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to Lucita."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to Lucita.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned his wheelchair toward me...."
entries.dialogueText: He turned his wheelchair toward me. Lucita helped him out of it.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Command me. What are your orders?""
entries.dialogueText: "Command me. What are your orders?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He knelt on the floor."
entries.dialogueText: He knelt on the floor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Taddeus Azaro. In light of your fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Taddeus Azaro. In light of your failures and incompetence, you are hereby incarcerated for a time of my choosing."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My Liege. My King.""

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Given the current state of the war..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the current state of the war, no. That said, the tide of war can turn, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If we stay the course, an opportun..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we stay the course, an opportunity might present itself."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""However, our enemy might seize one..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, our enemy might seize one for themselves."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Either way, it's a risk.""
entries.dialogueText: "Either way, it's a risk."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Hard to say. If we sue for peace,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hard to say. If we sue for peace, we stand to lose face in the eyes of the world, rendering us crippled."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Prolonging the conflict might dela..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prolonging the conflict might delay that, but our resources are limited."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Maybe for the short term, but our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe for the short term, but our resources are not infinite."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, however, our enemy might seiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, however, our enemy might seize one for themselves."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""It is a risk, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is a risk, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Unless the situation changes drast..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless the situation changes drastically... potentially years."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""At the end of the day, we have mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the end of the day, we have more resources than Pales and would win a war of attrition."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""But it would come at a cost.""
entries.dialogueText: "But it would come at a cost."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, but it would come at a cost.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but it would come at a cost."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Unlikely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Unlikely."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""But not impossible.""
entries.dialogueText: "But not impossible."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If they keep pushing into Montakla..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they keep pushing into Montaklar, they will gain a foothold in Rizia's interior."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Very good, Your Majesty. I knew yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty. I knew you would."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""What have you decided?""
entries.dialogueText: "What have you decided?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty. Peace i..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty. Peace it shall be."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""All my life, I believed I was dest..."
entries.dialogueText: "All my life, I believed I was destined to serve a higher purpose -- that I was meant for greatness."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Once again, presenting the same ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once again, presenting the same news that Taddeus Azaro delivered to your father so many years ago."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I fear I will be remembered not fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fear I will be remembered not for my achievements, but for my failures."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yet here I am. Defeated in battle.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yet here I am. Defeated in battle."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I'm sorry, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cast his eyes down in shame."
entries.dialogueText: He cast his eyes down in shame.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sat straighter."
entries.dialogueText: He sat straighter.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I'm sorry for failing you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry for failing you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to Lucita."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to Lucita.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""And you as well, my cousin.""
entries.dialogueText: "And you as well, my cousin."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He faced me again and took a deep b..."
entries.dialogueText: He faced me again and took a deep bow.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Command me. What are your orders?""
entries.dialogueText: "Command me. What are your orders?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""My Liege. My King.""
entries.dialogueText: "My Liege. My King."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a deep bow."
entries.dialogueText: He took a deep bow.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Carlos Robles Azaro, you will leav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos Robles Azaro, you will leave your post immediately and relinquish all of your duties. I am de-ranking you to Colonel."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, my King. I acknowledge my cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, my King. I acknowledge my change in my rank."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered himself back into his ch..."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered himself back into his chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed once more before my guards..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed once more before my guards came in and wheeled him out of the room.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, my King. I can't thank you en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, my King. I can't thank you enough for your forgiveness."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""I am grateful for your time, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am grateful for your time, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stood to leave."
entries.dialogueText: He stood to leave.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed to me and left the room."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed to me and left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned his wheelchair toward me,..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned his wheelchair toward me, then, with visible effort, he struggled as he lifted himself out of it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guards put the old man back in h..."
entries.dialogueText: My guards put the old man back in his wheelchair and took him out of the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door closed behind them with a..."
entries.dialogueText: The door closed behind them with a loud bang.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Which means Rizia would face the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which means Rizia would face the possibility of being dragged down along with Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos saluted, his hand trembling..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos saluted, his hand trembling slightly in my presence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gestured for him to join me at th..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured for him to join me at the table, and he promptly did.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was sitting at the table wit..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was sitting at the table with her arms crossed.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I know, Your Majesty. This is enti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, Your Majesty. This is entirely my fault."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yet here I am. The shameful last s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet here I am. The shameful last scion of a disgraced noble house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you admit it. The vaunted House..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you admit it. The vaunted House of Azaro is nothing but a bunch of weaklings who don't deserve the Crown's mercy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Prime Minister was rather irat..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister was rather irate that you vetoed the parliament's ceasefire bill. The government's now insisting we sue for peace."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Prime Minister and our new par..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister and our new parliament have already expressed their wish to sue for peace."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But they didn't fight the war. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "But they didn't fight the war. We did. And you're the one with the final say."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The Prime Minister was rather irat..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister was rather irate that you vetoed the parliament's ceasefire bill. The government wants us to sue for peace."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""The Prime Minister and our new par..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Prime Minister and our new parliament are urging us to sue for peace."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""But you're the one with the final..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're the one with the final say."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Or, well... there's nothing to dis..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or, well... there's nothing to discuss, actually. The new government has already decided that we're suing for peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She made a face."
entries.dialogueText: She made a face.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Ahem. Actually, there's nothing to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ahem. Actually, there's nothing to discuss. The Prime Minister has already decided to sue for peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dammit! We could've turned this ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dammit! We could've turned this around."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So why even bother meeting with me?""
entries.dialogueText: "So why even bother meeting with me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A reasonable decision. I have no q..."
entries.dialogueText: "A reasonable decision. I have no qualms with it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We should have done so already. *I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should have done so already. *I* should have."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our troops fought this war for you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our troops fought this war for you. You deserve to know how it ends."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Our army fought this war for you...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our army fought this war for you. You deserve to know how it ends."
